name: Tenali
source: Andhra Pradesh Space Applications Centre (APSAC) official AP Cadastral Map application, with Tenali Municipality official GIS-map route; no anonymous Tenali parcel response was verified.

queries.query: Tenali Andhra Pradesh official cadastral parcel map GIS land records; Tenali municipality official GIS map property parcel Andhra Pradesh
queries.result: Found the official Tenali Municipality Government of Andhra Pradesh site, its GIS-map route, the official APSAC AP Cadastral Map application, the Andhra Pradesh state GIS portal, and the DILRMP Tenali Mandal map-digitization record. The APSAC application configuration exposed a public ArcGIS web map and statewide cadastral MapServer URL, but the anonymous REST metadata request to that service returned HTTP 403.

queries.query: తెనాలి ఆంధ్రప్రదేశ్ అధికారిక భూ పటం కాడస్ట్రల్ పార్సెల్ భూమి రికార్డులు; తెనాలి మునిసిపాలిటీ అధికారిక GIS పటం భూ రికార్డులు
queries.result: Telugu-language discovery found official Andhra Pradesh land-record and BhuSeva references and the official AP cadastral-map/state GIS services. No Telugu-language Tenali-specific public parcel feature endpoint or downloadable safe parcel geometry was verified.

officialAndRelevantLeads.scope: Official AP Cadastral Map web application; web-map configuration references statewide cadastral service https://apsac.ap.gov.in/gisserver/rest/services/REVENUE/cadastral_ap_cache/MapServer.
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: The current public JavaScript/configuration was followed to the ArcGIS web map and service URL. No parcel response was retained because the service metadata route was denied anonymously. Statewide service intent was evidenced; Tenali coverage was not independently verified.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Tenali Municipality, Government of Andhra Pradesh / Commissioner & Director of Municipal Administration
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official municipal route exists, but its delivered page did not expose a public parcel feature service or safe native parcel identity in bounded shell inspection.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Government of India, Department of Land Resources, DILRMP
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official record lists Tenali Mandal village cadastral-map progress and fields for digitization, georeferencing, ROR linkage, and Bhu-Naksha use. This is status evidence, not a parcel feature feed.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Official APSAC dashboard loaded and linked to the AP Cadastral Maps application.
Current Web AppBuilder configuration exposed web map item b54a4a9a00b441a2bdd8f993d140edd5 and official cadastral MapServer URL; no parcel feature was requested from this configuration response.
Web-map data identified the operational cadastral layer as https://apsac.ap.gov.in/gisserver/rest/services/REVENUE/cadastral_ap_cache/MapServer.
Anonymous ArcGIS REST metadata request was denied by the official service host. No login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, credential, private token, unsafe field, or TLS exception was attempted.
Official Tenali municipal GIS route loaded. Bounded HTML/JavaScript inspection found no public parcel feature URL or schema.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official AP statewide cadastral application and Tenali municipal GIS route.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Application configuration and service identity only; no live anonymous parcel feature response.
coverageAssessment.registryExistenceScope: An official state cadastral map application and official Tenali municipal GIS route are evidenced; local parcel coverage and live access remain unverified.

qualityAssessment.geometryQuality: No geometry retained; anonymous service metadata request returned HTTP 403.

qualityAssessment.identityReadiness: Not assessed because no parcel feature response was obtained.
qualityAssessment.attributesRequested: No parcel attributes were requested or retained; owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax, account, and document fields were excluded.
